runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on official 2026/valid-current guidance, explicit effective-date handling and prevention of borough/system social-infrastructure evidence being converted into parcel-level capacity or delivery claims.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: Adopted 18 September 2024; sets homes/jobs targets and requirements for infrastructure and facilities including transport, schools and health centres.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Chapter 5 Social Infrastructure
sources.fact: Adopted plan includes Policy S1 social infrastructure, S2 health/social care facilities and S3 education/childcare facilities.

sources.label: DfE School Capacity survey 2026
sources.fact: SCAP is a statutory collection; 2026 collection opened 1 June and is due 31 July 2026.

sources.label: DfE pupil planning areas guidance
sources.fact: Published 29 May 2026; guidance is for local authorities defining pupil-planning-area structures used for SCAP.

sources.label: DfE Opening new schools statutory guidance
sources.fact: Published 18 May 2026 and comes into force 1 September 2026; before then the previous process continues.

sources.label: NHS England capital guidance 2026/27 to 2029/30
sources.fact: Sets 2026/27 capital framework, primary-care/ICB investment and explicit S106 developer-contribution collaboration with planning authorities; allocations do not by themselves prove a local facility will be delivered.

sources.label: NHS England capital guidance 2025/26
sources.fact: Explains healthcare developer contributions and requires NHS organisations to collaborate with local planning authorities; S106 is case-specific and ring-fenced to agreement purposes.

sources.label: LBBD JSNA 2024/27
sources.fact: JSNA summarises population health and wellbeing needs and is an evidence base for commissioning and strategy, not a parcel-level facility-capacity test.

sources.label: LBBD People and Resilience / Health and Wellbeing strategy
sources.fact: Council identifies the Joint Local Health and Wellbeing Strategy 2023-28 and planned 2025/26-2026/27 JSNA deep dives; strategic needs evidence is not site delivery proof.

sources.label: Barking and Dagenham SEND Local Offer
sources.fact: Current local offer describes education, health and care support for children and young people with SEND; service presence does not establish spare capacity for a development.

sources.label: LBBD EHC needs assessments and plans
sources.fact: EHC planning is an individual statutory support process; it cannot be converted into a generic school-capacity or parcel feasibility score.

sources.label: LBBD Developer contributions
sources.fact: CIL can help fund infrastructure including transport and schools; S106 can secure financial/non-financial mitigation, but neither mechanism proves a specific facility will be delivered for an unverified parcel.

examples.result: SCAP 2026 statutory status revalidated; collection data must be tied to the relevant planning area before any school-capacity inference.
Opening-new-schools guidance has a 1 September 2026 effective date and is not applied early on 27 July 2026.
NHS 2026/27 capital allocations are system/programme funding, not evidence that a particular GP or health facility exists or is funded for a candidate site.
NHS S106 guidance retains necessary/directly-related/scale-and-kind tests; generic healthcare growth evidence cannot create a parcel-specific obligation.
LBBD Local Plan infrastructure requirement is strategic and does not prove individual school or health-centre capacity at a parcel.
JSNA population-need evidence is retained as commissioning context, not a development-capacity measurement.
SEND/EHC service evidence is not converted into school-place availability or housing-delivery probability.
No social-infrastructure promotion occurs without exact parcel relation plus current site-specific capacity/commitment evidence.
